Anya: Heads-up — 03:12 UTC we saw a ~4x jump in p95 on prod. Traces point at heavy KV evicter activity on shard gs-12 during a cluster of long-context sessions (~1.5–2h). FIFO's in use for that shard. Suspect eviction cascade + reuse misses triggering KV pager storms. Logs and quick repro below.

Matt: Got it. Can you paste the repro command and a short `perf top` snapshot?

Anya: Repro (local):
```
./tools/replay --session-duration 7200 --batch-window 8ms --model rwd-v1 --trace kv_eviction
```
Top perf snapshot (sampling):
evicter_thread               37% CPU
kv_pager_io                  820 ops/s
rpc_handler                  12% CPU
95th_latency                 420ms  (baseline ~110ms)

Lee: If the evicter wakes and removes prefixes that are still being referenced by long sessions we rebuild KV blobs and hit IO. FIFO evicts oldest regardless of recent reuse — with sticky long-turn sessions that can amplify churn. :thinking:

Sarah: Quick mitigation idea — bump `reuse_threshold` from 1s -> 5s and raise `hotset_watermark` on gs-12 from 65% -> 78% to delay eviction pressure. Can we run that on a canary?

Matt: Pushed config to canary: `eviction.policy=fifo`, `reuse_threshold=5s`, `hotset_watermark=0.78`. deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded (gs-12-c). perf-bot: initial metrics after 5m: p50=95ms, p95=130ms, evicter_cpu=14%, kv_pager_io=230 ops/s.

Anya: Nice improvement. Still worried about correctness — saw 2 traces where reinserts and eviction ordering changed multi-shard contexts, leading to brief staleness in KV lookup. Might be a reinsert/evict race.

Lee: Added a safety check to the evicter to compare `entry->generation` before removal and set an atomic tombstone bit on evict path to avoid immediate reinsert races. PR #4219 opened.

Matt: Longer-term: implement a tiny probation LRU for candidates under eviction (probabilistic LRU) + an admission TTL so freshly-evicted entries aren't immediately readmitted. Also review batching heuristics — larger batch windows can correlate many long-context requests and amplify hotset pressure.

Anya: Agreed. I'll file a follow-up ticket with repro steps, raw logs, `perf top` outputs, and the traces. We should bisect FIFO vs LRU vs probation under identical workload. Tagging @sre to align rollback/runbook.

perf-bot: Created perf run 2026-03-18-01 with config variants (fifo, lru, probation). Results link: https://perf.internal/run/2026-03-18-01 :eyes:

Sarah: I'll own canary rollback plan and thresholds if p95 climbs back >200ms for 5m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary expanded to 4 hosts, monitoring dashboards updated.

Anya: Thanks all — leaving thread open until bisect completes. I'll upload the replay artifacts to the ticket and post the run IDs here.
